name: Re-body
summary:
Re-body is a socio-experimental crawler/exploration game.

The Re-body project was created out of an interest to explore body perception, especially of queer experiences. 38 individuals were asked a simple question: how do you feel about your body? Participants were encouraged to think about their feelings in the past and present, and analyze how those feelings may have evolved or not.

This experience functions simultaneously as a game and anthology; players explore a desolate environment while searching for fragments—manifestations of thoughts and memories—which reveal confessions, writings provided by the surveyed individuals.
